vocabulary.example: There's a problem with my timetable.

vocabulary.example: The meeting is scheduled for Monday.
I have two meetings at the same time.
It's chaos in the office today.

take action to solve a problem or talk to a person

vocabulary.meaning_en: keep someone busy so they don't get bored

fine_lines.title: formal vs informal offers
words: Is there anything I can do?
Can I give you a hand?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: Is there anything I can do? وLet me help عبارات مهذبة تناسب أي موقف. أما Can I give you a hand? وGive me a shout فهي غير رسمية وتناسب الزملاء.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Is there anything I can do?" and "Let me help" are polite and fit any situation. "Can I give you a hand?" and "Give me a shout" are informal, for colleagues.

examples.word: Is there anything I can do?
examples.sentence: Mr Lee, is there anything I can do for you?

examples.word: Can I give you a hand?
examples.sentence: Those boxes look heavy. Can I give you a hand?

fine_lines.title: help vs a hand
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نقول help someone أو help with something، ونقول give someone a hand with something. لا نقول give a help.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Say "help someone (with something)" or "give someone a hand (with something)". Don't say "give a help".

examples.sentence: Let me help you with your coat.
Can I give you a hand with your bags?

expressions.phrase: Is there anything I can do?
expressions.example: You look worried. Is there anything I can do?
Let me help. I know this program well.

expressions.phrase: Can I give you a hand?
expressions.example: Can I give you a hand with the chairs?

expressions.phrase: Give me a shout if you need anything.
expressions.meaning_en: An informal way to say "tell me if you need help later".
expressions.example: I'm at my desk. Give me a shout if you need anything.
Thanks, but I can handle this.

expressions.meaning_en: Politely show a visitor where to go.
expressions.example: Welcome, Mr Lime. Please come this way.

expressions.phrase: It's a pleasure to meet you.
expressions.meaning_en: A formal greeting for a client.
expressions.example: Mrs Kumquat, it's a pleasure to meet you.

grammar.title: Let me + base verb
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم Let me + فعل مجرد لعرض المساعدة أو للقيام بشيء بأنفسنا. لا نضع to بعد me: Let me help (وليس Let me to help).
grammar.explanation_en: Use "Let me + base verb" to offer to do something. No "to": Let me help (not "Let me to help").
examples: Let me help with your coat.
Let me carry that for you.

grammar.title: "anything" in questions
grammar.explanation_ar: في الأسئلة والنفي نستخدم anything بدل something: Is there anything I can do? Do you need anything?
grammar.explanation_en: In questions and negatives use "anything": Is there anything I can do?
examples: Is there anything I can do?
Give me a shout if you need anything.

questions.question: Which offer is informal?
choices: Is there anything I can do?
Can I give you a hand?
questions.explanation_ar: Can I give you a hand? غير رسمية.
questions.explanation_en: "Can I give you a hand?" is informal.

questions.question: Let me ___ you with your coat.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد Let me نستخدم الفعل المجرد.
questions.explanation_en: After "Let me" use the base verb.

questions.question: "Give me a shout" means...
questions.explanation_ar: give me a shout تعني ناديني أو أخبرني.
questions.explanation_en: It means tell me or call me.

questions.question: My computer has ___. It stopped working.
"I can handle this" means...
choices: I can hold this in my hand
I can deal with this myself
questions.explanation_en: It means I can deal with it.

questions.question: Tom had two meetings ___ the same time.
Choose the correct sentence.
choices: Can I give you a help?
Can I give you a hand?
Can I hand you a give?
questions.explanation_ar: العبارة الصحيحة give you a hand.
questions.explanation_en: The phrase is "give you a hand".

questions.question: You welcome a visitor and show the way. You say:
questions.explanation_ar: Please come this way عبارة مهذبة.
